title: Chapter 153 Dome Palace
content:
Chapter 153 Dome Palace

"Ah!! Ye clan, you'd better give me an explanation for the Dome Palace, otherwise, I will do my best to make you Ye clan pay the price!!"

The Lord of the Dome Palace was furious and pointed at the nose of the Ye clan leader.

But the Ye clan leader didn't even dare to fart.

It was from that time that everyone knew that the Ye clan had begun to degenerate.

Because the Ye clan back then was not afraid of any force.

But facing the Dome Palace, the Ye clan chose to surrender.

"Brother Chen, calm down, calm down!"

"My Ye clan will give you an explanation for the Dome Palace."

"Come here! Find Ye Lingzhi and kill him without mercy!!"

In order to calm the anger of the Dome Palace, Ye clan leader Ye Zhentian chose to sacrifice his own daughter.

And this also made him lose face on the other side of the starry sky.

But there was no way, because their Ye clan had really fallen into a trough now, otherwise, he would not choose to form an alliance with the Dome Palace.

I thought that this choice would bring the Ye clan back to life, but I never expected that I would lose more than I gained.

Now, Ye Zhentian regretted it.

Really regretted it.

Because his daughter not only survived, but also got a great opportunity.

Just look at the terrifying man in front of him and you will know.

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly stood up from the body of the strongest man of the Ye clan, and said lightly: "My wife has been wronged here, and I will naturally vent her anger."

"However, considering that you are his father, I will not kill you. From now on, your Ye clan and my wife will have no relationship. Do you understand?"

Hearing this, Ye Zhentian's face flashed a complex, silent for a moment, and finally nodded slowly.

He had no reason to refuse.

Of course, the most important thing is that he did not have the strength to refuse.

He had no doubt that as long as he dared to refuse, he would be beheaded in the next moment.

Seeing Ye Zhentian's reaction, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, then got up and left.

But when he reached the door, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped again.

Suddenly, Ye Zhentian trembled all over.

Not only Ye Zhentian, but all the surviving people in the Ye clan sank to the bottom of their hearts at this moment, looking at Lu Daosheng's back with horror.

This is a killing god.

Could it be that this killing god changed his mind?

Lu Daosheng suddenly said: "By the way, I hope that Lingyun will not know about this matter. Just pretend that I have never been here, understand?"

Hearing this, Ye Zhentian's face was extremely ugly and he gritted his teeth.

"Senior, I know."

After Lu Daosheng left, Ye Zhentian completely collapsed on the ground.

At this time, the rest of the Ye clan came to Ye Zhentian tremblingly.

"Clan, clan leader, what should we do now?"

In fact, after such a thing happened in the family, Ye Zhentian was no longer qualified to sit in the position of clan leader.

It's just that Lu Daosheng killed a lot of people this time.

The entire Ye clan's top leaders were almost completely bloodbathed.

The top expert of the Ye clan was killed instantly by Lu Daosheng and died tragically at his hands.

So now, except for Ye Zhentian, the Ye clan basically has no one who can be the clan leader.

Looking at the expectant eyes of the Ye clan members around him, Ye Zhentian sighed heavily and said slowly: "From now on, our Ye clan will completely withdraw from the world and cut off any contact with the outside world."

As soon as these words came out, the entire Ye clan was shocked.

"Clan leader, you..."

Ye Zhentian shook his head. He had no choice, but Lu Daosheng's last words were not just because he didn't want his daughter to know.

The other party was able to keep the people of their Ye clan, which was already a great kindness.

In the end, the Ye clan disappeared completely on the other side of the starry sky overnight, and no one knew what happened to the Ye clan.

At the same time, a strange man suddenly appeared in front of the gate of the Dome Palace, a super power.

"Who are you?"

The master of the Dome Palace felt a strange breath and instantly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, the Palace Master of the Dome Palace suddenly looked extremely solemn.

A peerless strong man.

Although he could not clearly feel Lu Daosheng's strength, he could feel that the other party's strength was far above his own.

When did such a strong man appear on the other side of the starry sky?

"Are you the Palace Master of the Dome Palace?"

"What can I do for you?"

Seeing that he was looking for him, Lang Hai's heart suddenly palpitated.

At this moment, he kept thinking in his heart whether he had offended the other party unintentionally, but no matter how he thought about it, he could not think of any connection with the person in front of him.

"Do you remember Ye Lingzhi?"

After coming here, Lu Daosheng knew the identity of his wife Yan Lingyun in her first life.

Ye Lingzhi, the daughter of the patriarch of the Ye clan.

And Yan Lingyun had never mentioned this to him. Obviously, Yan Lingyun did not want to tell him anything about her first life.

Thinking of his wife's experience, Lu Daosheng was heartbroken.

Abandoned by her relatives.

Yan Lingyun must have been desperate at that time.

When he heard Ye Lingzhi, Lang Hai paused, but his expression did not change at all.

"The daughter of the Ye clan leader, who in the entire starry sky knows her? Do you know her?"

At this time, Lang Hai was constantly observing the changes in Lu Daosheng's expression, hoping to infer something from it.

However, all he saw was Lu Daosheng's cold face.

"As far as I know, it seems that the marriage between Ye Lingzhi and the young master of your Dome Heavenly Palace was not proposed by the Ye clan leader at the beginning."

As soon as these words came out, Lang Hai slowly clenched his fists.

The eyes of Lu Daosheng also showed a hint of hostility.

"What does your lord mean?"

Lu Daosheng smiled coldly.

"What's the meaning?"

boom!

In an instant, a unimaginable pressure suddenly soared into the sky from Lu Daosheng's body.

The entire other side of the starry sky trembled at this moment.

Extremely terrifying!

Countless strong men looked in horror in the direction of the Dome Heavenly Palace.

I was shocked and confused.

When did such a powerful man appear in the dome sky?

Everyone thought this was a powerful man from the Dome Heavenly Palace, but they didn't know that the Lord of the Dome Heavenly Palace had already knelt down at this moment.

The terrifying pressure made Lang Hai kneel tightly on the ground, and even breathing became extremely difficult.

"Former, senior, please spare your life."

Lang Hai's face looked extremely ugly. He knew that the man in front of him would be very strong, but he didn't expect that he would be so strong.

It's really a terrifying evil!

At this time, Lu Daosheng had slowly walked in the depths of the Dome Heavenly Palace.

The next moment, countless masters of the Dome Heavenly Palace appeared beside Lang Hai.

All of his expressions were extremely solemn.

"Prince of the Palace, what should I do? Should I wake up the ancestor?"

As soon as these words came out, everyone said, "Parent Lord, let's wake up the ancestor."

"Yes, Palace Master, if the ancestor doesn't wake up again, my Dome Heavenly Palace will be over."

Hearing everyone's words, Lang Hai pondered for a moment, and finally took out a pale white talisman.

"Old ancestor, in trouble in the Heavenly Palace, please take action."

......

The field suddenly fell silent for a moment.

Everyone looked at the pale white talisman with confusion.

If Fu Li hadn't shined, everyone would have thought this thing was broken.

"Old ancestor?"

Langhai shouted again.

However, Fu Li did not move at all. The next moment, with a click, Fu Li was broken directly.

"Um?"

Everyone was stunned.

At this time, the deepest part of the Dome Heavenly Palace, in the forbidden area.

An old man quickly drilled into the characteristic coffin with lightning speed, then closed it directly, and kept yelling insults.

"This group of ancestral tricks really think I have lived for a long time!"

As early as the moment Lu Daosheng showed his breath, he had already awakened.

But so what? He won’t do anything about going out to give away the head.

What is the ending of the Dome Heavenly Palace? Let it be determined by heaven!
